overview.name: Columbia U.S. High Yield ETF
overview.description: Under normal market conditions, the fund invests at least 80% of its net assets (including the amount of any borrowings for investment purposes) in high-yield debt instruments (commonly referred to as “junk” bonds) issued by U.S. companies. The fund is non-diversified.
